design: Source-local general research concepts and attributed evidence-bearing relations; no inferred identity or external knowledge.

entity_types.Concept: A source-reported concept, feature, topic or category.
entity_types.Person: A person explicitly named in the source; matching names do not establish cross-source identity.
entity_types.Organization: A source-reported institution, group or organization.
entity_types.Place: A source-reported place; coordinates require separately evidenced geometry.
entity_types.TimeExpression: An exact source date, period or temporal expression; uncertainty and calendar are retained.
entity_types.Activity: A bounded source-reported event or activity occurrence, distinguished from an activity category.
entity_types.Artifact: An identified physical object; matching names do not establish shared identity.
entity_types.Material: A source-reported material or substance category; matching names do not identify the same physical sample.
entity_types.Language: A named language or variety explicitly reported by the source; place names do not infer language.
entity_types.Document: A work, reference or document explicitly cited by the source; cited contents are not automatically consulted.
entity_types.ActivityType: A source-reported category of activities or processes; not a particular event.
entity_types.ArtifactType: A source-reported category or form of objects, distinguished from individual artifacts; classification does not establish function.

related_to.definition: An explicitly reported relationship; co-occurrence alone is insufficient.

part_of.definition: An explicitly reported part, member or component relationship.

located_in.definition: A source-reported location; storage, production and recovery contexts must remain in scope.

dated_to.definition: An attributed date or period with uncertainty retained.

uses.definition: A directly reported use; do not infer function from an object name.

produces.definition: An explicitly reported product of a person, organization or activity.

participates_in.definition: Reported participation, with role and case preserved in scope.

has_feature.definition: An explicitly described feature, quoted from the source.

documents.definition: A document explicitly reports or describes an entity; cited works remain unconsulted leads unless ingested.

has_definition.definition: An exact attributed definition or description; use a literal value when appropriate.

aligns_reported_concept_with.definition: A reviewable comparison between source-local generic concepts; never accepted identity or fact transfer.
